authority.note: This file freezes replay-derived recognition parameters only. It must not enable the OpenHoldem Fantasy pixel path.

joker_samples.note: Both physical Jokers are independently visible in frame52, but one source occurrence each is not sufficient for runtime certification.

rank.distance: minimum XOR/union distance after integer translation alignment

only_failure.reason: The capture contains only one rank-8 exemplar; withholding it leaves no independent rank-8 template.

suit.feature: median RGB of the non-white suit glyph after slot-specific deskew

required_before_runtime_authority: Serialize/freeze actual rank glyph templates from replay-derived pixels with source provenance.
Prove exact full-card recognition on independent real 15-card fans, including rejection behavior rather than forced nearest class.
Acquire independent additional rank-8 evidence or another source-backed rank classifier that does not depend on a single 8 exemplar.
Calibrate JK1 and JK2 recognition with independent occurrences/visual states.
Obtain and calibrate real 14-, 16- and 17-card fan geometry; 15-card geometry must not be extrapolated silently.
Pass pixels -> recognizer -> RawOFCObservation -> Python/C++ canonical-state equality on real replay frames.
Keep ofc_fantasy_recognizer_calibrated=0 until all required evidence gates pass.
